proof: Each observed point separation component is bounded by (n-1)*spacing, and each time lag by (K-1)*dt. Triangle inequality bounds h-v*m*dt strictly below each half-period, so minimum-image distances never fold for any exported pair. All x offsets are multiples of5m, all y offsets multiples of40m.
scope: Exact covariance on exported lattice/time samples; no continuous off-lattice interpolation claim.
